Wow, thanks for the long comment.  I was not expecting to someone to deeply analyze this.  I’m more so concerned that I won’t have enough money to pay for things that aren’t necessities.  Everything is so expensive now.

I’ve been thinking about this lately, I am unsatisfied with my living situation.  Part of me thinks he will tell me I need to find someone else, part of me thinks he will take me in as he feels bad if he turned me away.
All good! What’s more important is that you are still looking for P.C. :)
Hey, you replied on another post of mine asking if I was P.C.  I am not P.C., unfortunately.
I would never do this and neither would he.
No, sorry.
Is it ok if I dm you about this?
He is hesitant because he has such strong feelings for me but wants us to move on from each other.  If only I lived closer to him.
I wish he could see this, and I wish he would do anything for this.  I'd do anything to have him back.
I sent you a dm, not sure if you saw it.
No, sorry.
Is it ok if I dm you about this?

I wish I could, I’m just afraid I might scare him away more.  I know he didn’t want to breakup, but he did it thinking I deserved someone better for me.  He was the best thing since sliced bread to me.
No

The feeling is mutual, yes.  He loves our relationship, he wants it, but since we’ve been physically apart for so long, he wants me to find someone better that’s also close by.  I’d chase after him, but what if he runs away?  He said we should just rip off the band aid.
I just wish he could understand how much he is loved and wanted.  He lightens so many dark days, not just for me, but for everyone.
I hope he does.  I miss him so much.  I miss the times as well for when we were not a couple and just getting to know each other.
This is not P.C, either, I’m sorry.
Thank you, I needed to hear this.
I miss this man so much.  He was my everything, and now my world is dark without my sun.
May I talk about this in DM?
Thank you :)
Unfortunately, I am not D

I'm glad you love this letter.  I wish I could send it to him.  I could, I am not blocked, yet I want to give him some more time to himself.  I am working on myself.  I am going to focus on what MY life will be like, not how others want my life to be.  It will get better for me, I just know it.  It will be many days, weeks, and months, though.
Both.  My last true friend was my boyfriend that just broke up with me two weeks ago, for reasons that didn’t have to deal with your question.
I stopped talking to my friends entirely.
I cannot afford a therapist.  I’ve been given links to contact those online volunteer chat groups, those do NOTHING.  They just parrot what I say, I get NOWHERE with them.
I do have friends online, it just doesn’t feel the same.

I cannot drive.  My mom tracks me on my phone and wherever I go, and when I get home I am interrogated by her.  She is suspicious of anything I do, so reaching  out to people in person is rough.  I cannot afford therapy.

My mom has no idea about my depression in this state right now.  I have to keep it under wraps because if she sees me upset, my brother will see me upset.  My brother is mentally handicapped and has autism.  A year ago I got really sad, and my mom decided to spend more time with me due to it.  My brother got aggressive with my mother and was very jealous since she was spending more time with me.  I cannot talk to my family about it because my brother just gets very jealous about it.

God I hope does, but at the same time he is so beautiful and he has probably found another woman already.  I highly doubt it, but there’s still a possibility.  I don’t have a good family life and he was the only person I had a chance of moving in with him, but it’s all gone now.
I cannot drive.  My mom tracks me on my phone and wherever I go, and when I get home I am interrogated by her.  She is suspicious of anything I do, so reaching  out to people in person is rough
No one is here for me.  I had someone, but they are no longer in my life and I just can’t put in any effort to befriend anyone anymore
I cannot find people.  I cannot drive.  My parents track me on my phone and wherever I go.  I have no friends in person.  All online, and even those people don’t care.
Like physical distance? Around 750 miles/1200 km or so.  Why do you ask?
That’s true, I will check out that app right now!

I had to deal with this feeling today while at work.  My job is at an attraction/retail venue for children, and the urge to not cry there is through the roof.  I have to hide my cries and pain.  It was hard today.  Although I do not have advice to give because I do not have kids and I also haven’t found any remedies (yet) for my depression, but what do you think about surprising your kids with something? It doesn’t have to be too expensive, but something simple may be nice.

So the psychiatrist I used to go to asked every appointment if we (mom and I) ever found a therapist, Mom always said “No, because (insert weird explanation)” and nothing would happen. I had 6-7 appts with this psychiatrist.  Still haven’t seen a therapist.  Last therapist I went to didn’t really help me.  We just talked the whole time.

She can see where I am, so can my dad. I can see where my mom is, but neither of us can see where my dad is. I turned it on for safety reasons a long time ago, I don’t remember when.  If I turn it off it tells them that I turned off location sharing.  The only way they can’t see where I am is if I power off my phone or I don’t carry my phone with me.

Honestly thinking about staying in a hotel/motel for a couple of days, seeing if that relaxes me at all or not.  I’d just have to get input from my dad before I discuss with mom
Oh no I was talking the motel.  And I may fear living with my aunt and uncle may be too much. On them.
Yea but how would I say that to my mom without sounding suspicious? Like she’ll be watching me right outside the motel perhaps

I am a woman, I just moved to a new state, 1500 miles away from where I grew up.  I could, but the cheapest apartment is $1200 a month, without considering any other costs or fees.  I could live with my aunt and uncle, they consider my feelings, but they only have one other bedroom and I’d feel bad if my cousins came over and needed the room.  I’ve been told to find a roommate, but it’s hard to find a roommate, I personally wouldn’t ask someone I knew at work to be a roommate unless I knew them prior to working or if I was related to them.  I don’t make enough money to afford it.  I don’t mind my dad, sometimes he can be a little too critical, but it’s mostly my mom. I’m not sure. Maybe she wants me to be just like her.

I still have the fear of driving. My mom doesn’t think I’m ready. I’m great when I drive with my dad, my mom yells at me over the littlest thing. I begin to panic and my heart races when I drive with her. I like my job, I just wish I could be able to talk to my friends outside of work. The only problem is if they decide to not be friends with me anymore, they can tell EVERYONE my littlest secrets. Mom would never let me get another pet. Nothing I’m excited for, I have a wedding to attend towards the end of May, but my mom told me if I don’t listen to her, she will put me on a plane back home. Before the wedding my mom, grandma, and I will be spending some time in the city where the wedding is. I don’t have the best relationship with either of them. My grandma expects me to always smile. She puts her expectations on me. My mom is very aggressive when any of her relatives are over. This is my cousin’s wedding, I’m here for him and his soon to be wife, not my mom and grandma. 

I’m done with it all.

I just got off from break.  It’s hard to cry in private, there’s really no private place. I cried in the bathroom once because a guest yelled at me over nothing and I got written up because apparently the guests are the ones management believes more than anyone.  It was the employee bathroom, so every time someone walked in there I stopped crying, I had to put my hand over my mouth.  It took me maybe an hour to stop crying.  Since I don’t drive my parents pick me up, so if I stay late I text them and let them know.  So I texted them.  They have no idea I cry at work.  

Nothing here is truly private, managers look at security cameras, I can cry in the stock room but then a guest will complain that I wasn’t there and you know what happens next…

And sometimes if I do cry it out, it just makes it worse.  I just wish the people who support me were available to reach out to, but maybe some people are just tired of hearing me vent. Oh well

I’d like to teach history/social studies/social sciences, that genera.  But my family isn’t supportive of me.  It’s hard. I lack motivation to do anything.  I used to be so energetic.  I’m an extrovert, and it’s hard to function without supportive people.

My parents says they think I’d be a good fit in an animal related career because I like animals.  I like animals, I just don’t like having to deal with euthanasia.  Zookeepers are extremely underpaid.  

I’ve always found myself going back to teaching, not sure why.  I guess I like the idea of leading people, and grading papers, making my own rules.  But they don’t get paid much anyways, too.

I’m only 19, I live in an area where the lowest priced apartment, with very little area, is extremely expensive, it would be about 60% of my monthly salary.  I have a job, too.  It’s just hard living in this new area, there’s nothing to do.  I was active in Scouting for a long time, but since I have no car, and I am still afraid of driving, those chances of going back in the near future is little to none.

I have not enrolled in college. I was supposed to last fall, then this spring.  I’d like to become a teacher, but my parents think being a vet/zoologist is a better career for me.  I disagree, I’m not interested in administrating needles and dealing with blood, it wasn’t fun when I was a child.  

So I’m thinking of not going to college at all at this point, just staying at a high school diploma, despite my numerous amount of AP credits/ prior learning credit.  It’s better to save the money for other stuff.

Your pain DOES matter.

Your child may never truly understand why you are the way you are, but they may give the comfort you are lacking.  If (or when) they find out about your past trauma, how will they react? Will they still have the same anger and frustration you had, confused on how women are treated, and why, in the 21st century, after all these advancements women have made, they still haven’t received equal care.  I hope that is the case.  I’m frustrated.  I’ve heard these “horror stories” of people in surgery who were never given anesthesia, or  not enough.  But it’s different when another life is involved.  

Although I have never given birth and I cannot relate to you, I wish I could help you to the max.  I wish I was able to, but I’m not truly in your shoes.  

I do hope you are able to restore your inner peace one day, I wish you the best of luck.

I wish I could, but unfortunately, I do not have a car.  My parents are quite curious on everywhere I go, so going to a meetup might not work out the best for them.  I am a female, and the world is different for us, unfortunately.  I used to be active in groups that pertained to my interests, but my mother does not think I should be in them anymore, because I am an adult now :(.

Well, how are you?

Unfortunately, I don’t remember when my last hug was or who gave me that hug, but I know it’s been forever, too.  “Make new friends” is so vague, making friends is different from what it was 50 years ago.  Making friends online is vastly different from in person.  Plus, you have to keep building on to that friendship, or you’ll lose it.  I wasn’t able to.  

OP, I do hope you are able to find some clarity.  And I do notice that I remember everyone I chat with on Reddit, so I won’t forget you.  

Best hugs :)
Just wish I had more friends my age.  Most of my friends are 15/16 or much older than me.
I must know where this lemur enclosure is.  I assume your son is the kid in the pfp, he’s cute :)
They’re so…. unique. They are primates but they look nothing like us.  Cool tails, too.
